if(NOT SYMBOL_FORMAT)
    set(SYMBOL_FORMAT Zi)
endif()
if(NOT SYMBOL_FORMAT MATCHES "^(Zi|ZI|Z7)$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Unsupported MSVC symbol format")
endif()
add_library(binary_symbols_dependency STATIC dependency.cpp)
target_compile_options(binary_symbols_dependency PRIVATE "/${SYMBOL_FORMAT}")
set_target_properties(binary_symbols_dependency PROPERTIES COMPILE_PDB_NAME binary_symbols_dependency_compiler)
add_library(binary_symbols STATIC library.cpp)
target_include_directories(binary_symbols PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../include")
target_link_libraries(binary_symbols PRIVATE ${ENGINE_NAME} binary_symbols_dependency)
target_compile_options(binary_symbols PRIVATE "/${SYMBOL_FORMAT}")
set_target_properties(binary_symbols PROPERTIES COMPILE_PDB_NAME binary_symbols_compiler)
